gemma2:9b.title: The Deep Hot Biosphere: The Myth of Fossil Fuels

The book delves into the implications of this theory for our understanding of energy resources and the future of energy consumption.

gemma2:9b.title: The Origin of the Solar System
gemma2:9b.explanation: Presents Gold's unique perspective on the formation of our solar system.
